lines.text: Solomon loved many foreign women, though the LORD had told the Israelites not to intermarry with their nations.
Solomon had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and in his old age they turned his heart.
Solomon followed Ashtoreth and Milcom, and on a hill east of Bethlehem he built a high place for Chemosh.
The LORD grew angry because Solomon's heart had turned away, and He said He would tear the kingdom away and give it to Solomon's servant.
The LORD would not tear the kingdom away in Solomon's lifetime, but would give ten tribes to Solomon's son.
